issue.title: Stabilize plugin action modal scroll test under full-suite load
issue.description: During unrelated coder-alias verification on 2026-08-03, full just check failed tests/ace/tui/test_plugin_action_confirm_modal.py::test_plugin_action_modal_scrolls_overflowing_preview, but the same node passed in the immediate focused rerun. This looks like full-suite/xdist timing or layout-state sensitivity in the overflowing preview scroll assertion, not a deterministic regression in the alias changes. Reproduce under suite load, determine whether the modal interaction or test wait condition owns the flake, and make it deterministic while preserving coverage that overflowing plugin action previews scroll correctly.
